x87.semantics: The quotient is computed at the x87 intermediate precision and rounded to float once before being stored and once more, from the same float, before being compared. Reproduced with a double intermediate, matching the default 53-bit control word.
x87.residual_risk: Under a 64-bit precision control word the double rounding could differ in the last bit. No such change was found on this path and it cannot bite at realistic screen dimensions.
